text: FOL ::: ∀x (BalancedDiet(x) ∧ IncludesFruits(x) ∧ IncludesVegetables(x) ∧ IncludesLeanProteins(x) → ProvidesNutrients(x) ∧ PromotesHealthAndWellness(x)) ::: A balanced diet that includes a variety of fruits, vegetables, and lean proteins can provide essential nutrients and promote overall health and wellness.
